item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 15/Sep/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will bring heavy showers and thunderstorms to southern China and the northern part of the South China Sea in the next couple of days. With the trough of low pressure weakening, showers will lessen and the weather will improve slightly over the coastal areas of Guangdong early next week. A surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to affect the coast of southeastern China in the middle and latter parts of next week. The weather will be mainly fine during the day over the region.

Date/Month: 15/09 (Friday)
Wind: East to southeast force 4, occasionally force 5 offshore.
Weather: Cloudy with showers and a few squally thunderstorms. Showers will be heavy at times.
Temp range: 25 - 28 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
